name: PICNIC_TRUCK_PARKING_8_KM_BLUE_LONG

service_picnic_area.desc: Picnic area symbol (tree with picnic table), 800x800 box; drawn 695x708 ink centred in its 800x800 box (element box = ink extent, since the generator fits the symbol to its box).

service_truck_parking.desc: Truck parking symbol (letter P above a semi-trailer), 960x800 box; drawn 823x617 ink centred in its 960x800 box (element box = ink extent, since the generator fits the symbol to its box).

notes: 2440x1920 R240; blue 50 / white 50. 260 | 800 | 200 | 400 E | 260 = 1920; symbols 260 | 800 | 160 | 960 | 260. '8 km': = | Varies (numeral 400 E, 8 illustrated) | 200 | 700 (km 340 Emod) | = -> one centred runs line; km baseline 1660. Service symbols: the drawing dimensions the symbol boxes (service_picnic_area 800x800 at 260,260; service_truck_parking 960x800 at 1220,260); the pictograms do not fill them, so each element box is the pictogram's ink extent measured from the drawing, centred in the dimensioned box (nominal_box).
